title: Python package cache (uv)
description: Downloaded and unpacked Python packages that uv uses to build .venv environments. On APFS, uv clones files into .venv, so less space is actually freed than the size shows.
regeneration: uv downloads the packages again on the next install.
note: Runs uv cache clean on exactly this folder.

title: npm package cache
description: Archives of packages downloaded by npm. Project installs reuse them instead of downloading the same package again.

title: Packages downloaded by npx
description: Tools run through npx (including MCP servers). Each subfolder is one download.
regeneration: They are downloaded again the next time npx runs them.

title: npm logs
description: npm error and debug logs.

title: Gradle cache
description: Downloaded Maven/Gradle dependencies and library transforms (Android, Flutter, Kotlin).
regeneration: The next build downloads the dependencies again; the first build will be slow.

title: Downloaded Gradle distributions
description: Gradle versions downloaded by gradlew in projects. Each subfolder is one version.
regeneration: gradlew downloads the required version on the next build.

title: Gradle temporary files and daemon logs
description: Temporary files and logs of Gradle daemon processes.

title: Homebrew download cache
description: Downloaded bottles and installers of Homebrew packages. Installed programs do not use them.
regeneration: Homebrew downloads the files again when installing or upgrading.

title: pip cache
description: Packages downloaded and wheels built by pip.

title: System Python cache
description: Compiled .pyc files of the Python that ships with macOS and the Xcode tools.

title: Old Playwright browser versions
description: Playwright downloads browsers separately for each of its versions. These are older versions of Chromium, WebKit and ffmpeg; the newest of each kind is kept.
regeneration: npx playwright install downloads the required version.

title: Current Playwright browsers
description: The newest browser versions downloaded by Playwright, used by end-to-end tests and automation tools (including MCP servers).

title: Puppeteer browsers
description: Chromium and Chrome downloaded by Puppeteer.
regeneration: They are downloaded again when the puppeteer package is installed.

title: Bun install cache
description: Packages downloaded by bun install.

title: Yarn cache
description: Packages downloaded by Yarn.

title: pnpm package store
description: The shared pnpm package store; projects link to it with hard links.
regeneration: pnpm install downloads the packages again.

title: NuGet packages
description: Downloaded .NET packages used by projects (Rider, dotnet build).

title: NuGet HTTP cache
description: NuGet server responses saved during restore.

title: Dart packages (pub)
description: Packages downloaded from pub.dev for Flutter and Dart projects.
regeneration: flutter pub get downloads them again.

title: Dart analyzer cache
description: Code analysis results of the Dart language server (IDE suggestions).
regeneration: Rebuilt when the project is opened in an IDE.

title: Old Flutter SDK versions (FVM)
description: Flutter versions installed by FVM, except the newest. Projects pinned to an older version will not build until you install it again.

title: Old Node.js versions (nvm)
description: Node.js versions installed by nvm, except the newest, together with their global packages.

title: nvm download cache
description: Downloaded Node.js installation archives.

title: CocoaPods cache
description: Downloaded CocoaPods pods and specs.

title: Swift Package Manager cache
description: Cloned repositories of Swift package dependencies.

title: Go build cache
description: Build results of Go packages.

title: Cargo package registry
description: Downloaded and unpacked Rust crates.

title: Local Maven repository
description: Java libraries downloaded by Maven, together with artifacts installed locally (mvn install, install:install-file). Locally installed artifacts may exist nowhere else.
regeneration: Maven downloads public libraries again. Your own installed artifacts come back only if you build or install them again.

title: Tools and Python versions installed by uv
description: Python interpreters and command-line tools installed by uv (uv python install, uv tool install). Removing them disables those tools.
regeneration: uv tool install / uv python install.

title: Installed Node.js (nvm)
description: The current Node.js version from nvm, together with globally installed packages.

title: .NET SDK installed locally
description: .NET SDKs and runtimes installed in the home folder by the dotnet-install script.
